name: Bombardier CRJ700/900
summary: Stretched, re-winged development of the CRJ200 seating 50–90; flown by Endeavor, PSA, SkyWest, GoJet and Mesa.

wings: Larger swept wing with leading-edge slats
engines: Two CF34-8C turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Long, slim 4-abreast fuselage — the 900 looks especially long and thin
tail: T-tail with a larger tailplane spanning wider than on the CRJ200

tellTales: Long, thin tube with rear engines and a T-tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The CRJ700/900 is much longer with a bigger slatted wing and larger tailplane; the CRJ200 is short and compact.
The CRJ700/900 has rear-mounted engines and a T-tail; the E175 has underwing engines, a low tail and a fatter double-bubble fuselage.
The CRJ is slimmer and has winglets and a longer pointed nose; the 717 has a fat 5-abreast body, plain wingtips and a bullet fairing on the T-tail.
